reviews.comment:
LADRONES!!!!!
NO CARGUEN CON DÉBITO. Los posnet en las islas no tienen Internet, se corta la conexión, pero te hacen pasar la tarjeta igual. Resultado: duplican la venta. Como el banco acredita  que se les pagó  2 veces, es la estacion la que debe  devolver la plata pero el ACA se niega. Es una trampa.
Se llenan la boca con el servicio y son unos ladrones.

(Translated by Google)
THIEVES!!!!!
DON'T USE DEBIT CARDS. The POS terminals at the gas stations don't have internet access; the connection drops, but they still swipe your card. The result: they double-charge you. Since the bank confirms they were paid twice, the station is supposed to refund the money, but the ACA (Automobile Club of Argentina) refuses. It's a scam.
They boast about their service, but they're thieves.
